name: bare
label: Bare
description: Toggling pre-bundled styling for the component

name: scrollable
label: Scrollable
description: You can let users scroll vertically, horizontally, or both directions. To keep the page fixed, select None.

name: headerLevel
label: Header Level
description: Heading level used to generate the correct level Heading tag. Default value is '1'.

name: headingOnlyVisibleToScreenReaders
label: Heading level only visible to screen readers
description: If you want the heading to only be visible to Screen Readers, then set this property to true.

name: interceptNotifications
label: Intercept notifications
description: If you want to handle notifications using a custom component, or completely suppress notifications, set this property to true.

name: propagateNotifications
label: Propagate notifications
description: If you want to have a parent page handle any notifications, set this property to true and all events will continue to bubble up to the parent.
